techStack: React 19.0.0 with TypeScript ~5.7.2; JSX automatic transform (no explicit React imports needed)
State management: React Context API only — FilterContext, ProductContext, FavouritesContext, ComparisonContext
Build: tsc -b && vite build (type-check first, then bundle); strict TS flags: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters — any leftover unused variable is a build error
No import path aliases — all imports use relative paths (e.g., '../context/FilterContext')
verbatimModuleSyntax: true — use 'import type' for type-only imports
features: localSortBy declared at ProductListPage.tsx:31 (useState<SortOption>('default')), used at line 80 as SortSelect value/onChange — must be removed entirely
SortSelect props: { value: FilterState['sortBy'], onChange: (sortBy: FilterState['sortBy']) => void } — no change needed to SortSelect itself

onCategoryClick no-op passed at ProductListPage line ~97 to ProductList, drilled at ProductList line ~23 to ProductCard, called at ProductCard line ~48 as onCategoryClick?.(product.category) — entire chain must be removed
FilterContext already exposes sortBy, setSortBy, setCategory — no changes to FilterContext needed
Other working features that must not regress: search (300ms debounce), category <select> in FilterPanel, in-stock toggle, clear filters (resets category to 'All' and sort to 'default'), pagination
architecture: Context consumed via useFilterContext() custom hook — NOT useContext(FilterContext) directly; hook throws if used outside FilterProvider
FilterProvider wraps app at root (ProductProvider > FilterProvider > others > BrowserRouter), so ProductCard always has access to FilterContext
Pattern for consumption: destructure needed values at top of component body before return (e.g., const { sortBy, setSortBy } = useFilterContext())
New context calls in ProductCard go at top of function body alongside any existing hooks
Directory layout: pages/ (ProductListPage), components/ (ProductCard, ProductList, SortSelect, FilterPanel), context/ (FilterContext), hooks/ (useFilteredProducts)
edgeCases: Initial 'default' sort: removing localSortBy means SortSelect reads context's initial sortBy which is already 'default' — no special handling needed
Category 'All' reset: clearFilters() already resets context.category to 'All'; covered by clearFilters.test.tsx — must remain unbroken

noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters: removing localSortBy must also remove setLocalSortBy and the useState import if it becomes unused; removing onCategoryClick from Props must be clean across all three files
onCategoryClick was optional (onCategoryClick?.) in ProductCard — removal must also clean the Props type, not just the call site
TypeScript will error at any file that still references a removed prop — all three files (ProductCard, ProductList, ProductListPage) must be updated atomically before the build passes
ProductCard rendered outside FilterProvider: not a supported scenario per spec; useFilterContext() guard is already present in context — no extra handling required
